context.summary: RWVB range/domain checks rely primarily on inequalities; several NaN/Infinity values can evade those guards and poison debt, priority, or fan-out arithmetic.

objective: Require every floating-point Candidate and ControllerConfig input used by RWVB to be finite before applying existing range/domain checks, while preserving all current finite scheduling and fan-out behavior.

outputs.description: Unverified candidate patch against the successor-v2 source snapshot.

security.notes: Public repository task. Worker must not modify evaluator/control artifacts. Candidate correctness is determined independently; worker self-report is not acceptance.

uncertainty.resolution_strategy: Require issue #180 calibration gate and task-specific behavioral regression where safe.
uncertainty.statement: EvaluatorPlan v0.4 transition checks are a static proxy and must be calibrated against a straightforward transition plus a near-miss before cohort freeze.

validators.description: Worker output must validate as ResultManifest v0.1.
Independent evaluator must verify artifact/log integrity, patch scope, calibrated transition evidence, and any separately required behavioral evidence.

verification_policy.acceptance_rule: Both required validators must pass; worker self-report and static transition support are not merge authority. Successor-v2 freeze additionally requires pre-outcome evaluator calibration.
